ResearchProjectDef.label: arm blade module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to extend a concealed blade from within their forearm.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bionic claw module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a bionic module that allows the user to extend retractable plasteel claws from each of their digits and grants their hand enough grip strength to crush skulls like eggshells.
Modules can be self-installed into modified bionic or archotech parts, but can only be ejected by removing the part.
